craft_notes: Sthāyin: nāda-vīra of heard doings resolving to jaya-śānta of conquering close — the treatise ends in blessing (end-prosperity). Way-ungrasping; all-ways-entered; Bhairavī-standing goal. Rejected: (a) standing→state → killed: standing keeps posture. Read aloud: BY a-WAY un-GRASP-ing … SHOULD-en-TER.

lines: By a way ungrasping — to-do, to-gain, Bhairavī-standing —
which, that own-knowing — all ways — should enter.
l4.sanskrit_cite: upāyenāgrahaḥ kārya upeyā bhairavīsthitiḥ yāsau svasaṃvit tām eva sarvopāyāṃ samāviśet

reads_against.argmap: What all-means enters self-knowing? → Means-ungrasping; self-knowing all-means-entered.
reads_against.c1_rasa: nāda-vīra of heard doings; vīra of straitened exchange; karuṇa-adbhuta of unenjoying goddesses; vīra of all-ways entering; vīra of attained mystery; jaya-śānta of conquering close
